E-Sys MAX 5.2.8

New
- Japanese (beta): the launcher, every window inside E-Sys and the coding ideas.

Improved
- Numbers read naturally in every language: "1 module" and "5 modules", with the right word form in Russian, Romanian, Spanish, Italian and German, and the right counter word in Japanese, Korean and Chinese.

- Turkish capital letters (İ) and Korean line breaks look right.
- Messages name each button exactly as it appears on screen.
- A few messages and window titles that were still in English are now translated.

Includes everything in 5.2.7.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
